title: Renewal Rollout Series
description: A reference-dependent New Year campaign system that locks a fresh-cycle visual world and extends it across multiple renewal offers.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes a bright, disciplined renewal environment built from fresh light, clean surfaces, and optimistic organization; images 02-04 preserve that exact language while translating it into fitness, home reset, and learning-planner offers.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-fresh-desk-anchor first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-fitness-reset-variation, 03-home-reset-variation, 04-learning-planner-variation. Queue may run the dependent images concurrently after 01-fresh-desk-anchor is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
